relationships.subject: Inflammatory mediators
relationships.evidence_quote: which can act through diverse signaling cascades to modulate expression and activity of ion channels including VGSCs

relationships.subject: Protein kinases
relationships.evidence_quote: with a specific focus on direct phosphorylation of these channels by multiple protein kinases

key_findings: Review: pro-nociceptive inflammatory mediators regulate Nav1.7, Nav1.8 and Nav1.9 via kinase signaling and direct phosphorylation.
Nav1.7-1.9 are nearly exclusively expressed in peripheral neurons and mutations cause inherited pain disorders.
